description: This is a Python source file for a chatbot or AI assistant that integrates multiple services including speech recognition, text-to-speech, and large language models. It sets up a pipeline for processing audio and text, handles client connections, and logs search responses. It also defines transport configurations and a main function to run the bot.

classes.name: LLMSearchLoggerObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs when an LLM search response frame is pushed, specifically for debugging search responses.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Handles the event when a frame is pushed; logs details if the frame is an LLM search response.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the main bot pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot pipeline.
